title: TBD Map Tile Index
description: Every cartographic map tile file of one terrain, served at `/map-assets/<terrain>/tiles/map/index.json` next to the tile pyramid it lists. `cargo xtask map tile-index --terrain <terrain>` writes it from the pyramid on disk; the page reads it to list the offline pack. Tiles are ordered by zoom, then column, then row, and each (z, x, y) appears once. A tile's URL is the terrain manifest's `tiles.map.urlTemplate` with `{z}`, `{x}` and `{y}` substituted.

terrainId.description: The terrain the tiles belong to; equals the manifest's `terrainId`.

tiles.description: Every tile file of the pyramid.

y.description: Row in the XYZ disk layout, below 2^z.
